messages.text:
Hello HeliumDeploy Team,

I am very disappointed with the customer service I have received regarding
order Shop····. I have purchased four miners from HeliumDeploy and have
been happy with your products, but the repeated delays and lack of
follow-through on this order are unacceptable.

Here is the timeline of my order and follow-ups:

Date (2026)| Order and support history
October 8| Order Shop···· placed for the NEXUS QX1; $278 paid, including
shipping.
October 15| Original expected shipping date passed.
October 16| I contacted support. Sarah confirmed the order had not shipped
and said the team would confirm a new date.
October 28| I followed up again and was told the manufacturer had not
provided a new shipping date.
October 29| You offered a free swap to the Hammer Miner Thor P2, stated it
was in stock at your US warehouse, and promised shipment within two
business days of my reply. I accepted that morning.
October 30| Sarah said nothing else was needed from me and that internal
approval was expected that morning, followed by shipment within two
business days.
November 4| I followed up and was told the team would contact me directly
shortly.
November 6| I was asked whether I wanted the swap again, despite already
accepting it. After I clarified, I was told approval was still pending.
November 10| I followed up again. Sarah confirmed the Thor P2 was in stock,
but the swap still needed senior approval.

As of today, November 13, it has been 36 days since my order, 29 days past
the original expected shipping date, and 15 days since I accepted your swap
offer. I still have no updated order confirmation, shipping notice, or
tracking number for the Thor P2.

I appreciate the free swap and the discount you offered, but an offer made
by your company should not remain unfulfilled for more than two weeks
because of an internal approval. I should not have to keep following up to
get the same answer.

Please have a human representative who can approve and complete the swap
review this history and email me directly. I need confirmation of whether
the swap has been processed, an explanation of the continued delay, and a
firm shipping date, with tracking once dispatched.

I am asking for someone to take ownership of this and provide a concrete
update. Another automated response saying the issue has been passed to the
team will not resolve it.

Thank you,
Robert H.
Handed to the team · $137 waiver is over the $100 I can waive myself; customer explicitly wants a hum
